const listBudgets = `-- name: ListBudgets :many
SELECT id, code, tenant_id, status, deleted, creator_id, modifier_id, created_at, updated_at, remark, project_id, legal_entity_id, mode, total_approved, total_adjusted, pending_delta, version, approved_at, approved_by, policy_pack_id FROM F_BUDGET
WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = $1::bigint
  AND ($2::bigint IS NULL OR project_id = $2::bigint)
  AND ($3::text IS NULL OR status = $3::text)
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT $5::int OFFSET $4::int
`

type ListBudgetsParams struct {
	TenantID  int64   `json:"tenant_id"`
	ProjectID *int64  `json:"project_id"`
	Status    *string `json:"status"`
	Offset    int32   `json:"offset_"`
	Limit     int32   `json:"limit_"`
}

func (q *Queries) ListBudgets(ctx context.Context, arg ListBudgetsParams) ([]FBudget, error) {
	rows, err := q.db.Query(ctx, listBudgets,
		arg.TenantID,
		arg.ProjectID,
		arg.Status,
		arg.Offset,
		arg.Limit,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var items []FBudget
	for rows.Next() {
		var i FBudget
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&i.ID,
			&i.Code,
			&i.TenantID,
			&i.Status,
			&i.Deleted,
			&i.CreatorID,
			&i.ModifierID,
			&i.CreatedAt,
			&i.UpdatedAt,
			&i.Remark,
			&i.ProjectID,
			&i.LegalEntityID,
			&i.Mode,
			&i.TotalApproved,
			&i.TotalAdjusted,
			&i.PendingDelta,
			&i.Version,
			&i.ApprovedAt,
			&i.ApprovedBy,
			&i.PolicyPackID,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, i)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
